L31·N8683unmasked layer
Weak positive firing on ordinary mid-sentence continuation tokens (function words like "you"/"to", or first sub-word of a proper name) inside flowing boilerplate prose, while the neuron's real signal is strong negative activation on tokens embedded in structured, enumerated data — digit/measurement lists, email-address characters, comma-separated name+instrument listings, and the "Save As" UI phrase.
